activity_summary: Alone, you said Alse has never seen a play, that she heard the oath and asked who cooks, and that she had the hole in the first minute. You stopped there. You did not go on to tomorrow's yard.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Spoke the memo alone and stopped.

facets.activity: Said Alse asked who cooks, and stopped

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: She had the hole in the first minute. Good.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The girl has never seen a play.
